column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each disaster record (e.g., 'DIST0001').
A TIMESTAMP indicating when this disaster event record was created (e.g., '2025-04-15 10:30:00').
An enum (HazType_enum) describing the primary hazard type; possible values include 'Wildfire', 'Earthquake', 'Tsunami', 'Flood', 'Hurricane'.
An enum (HazLevel_enum) specifying the hazard’s severity level; possible values include 'Level 1', 'Level 2', 'Level 3', 'Level 4', 'Level 5'.
A VARCHAR(100) naming the geographic area impacted by the disaster (e.g., 'Coastal Region').
A CHAR(10) tagging the region code (e.g., 'REG001').
A NUMERIC(9,6) capturing the latitude coordinate of the affected area (e.g., 34.052235).
A DECIMAL(10,7) capturing the longitude coordinate (e.g., -118.243683).

JSONB column. Consolidates impact-related metrics of the disaster including population effects, infrastructure damage, and communication status.
Fields: {"communication":"An enum (CommNetState_enum) for communication network status; possible values: 'Limited', 'Operational', 'Down'.","damage_level":"An enum (DamageReport_enum) labeling the damage severity; possible values: 'Severe', 'Moderate', 'Minor', 'Catastrophic'.","infrastructure":{"damage_percent":"A DECIMAL(5,2) measuring infrastructure damage as a percentage (e.g., 45.30).","power_outage_percent":"A DECIMAL(7,3) capturing the percentage of power outages (e.g., 75.200).","water_damage_percent":"An INT indicating the water system damage percentage (e.g., 60)."},"population":{"affected":"An INTEGER counting how many people are affected (e.g., 150000).","casualties":"An INTEGER representing the total number of fatalities (e.g., 50).","displaced":"An INTEGER indicating the number of displaced individuals (e.g., 10000).","injured":"An INT logging how many were injured (e.g., 200).","missing":"An INT showing how many persons are missing (e.g., 25)."},"transportation":"An enum (TransportAccess_enum) describing transportation accessibility; possible values: 'Full', 'Limited', 'Minimal'."}
